Aisha (Product): Heads-up: AcmeCorp pushed a hard requirement today — they need per-tenant audit exports, BYOK support (customer-managed keys), and a documented retention+legal-hold flow before they sign the SOW. Asking for a launch window in 6–8 weeks. Thoughts?
Miguel (Security): Can we scope a minimal BYOK handshake first? KMS integration + key metadata storage, no long-term escrow initially. Legal-hold flow needs immutability guarantees.
Devon (Engineering): From infra POV: two parts — (1) streaming audit events to tenant-owned S3/GCS and (2) on-platform archival with retention tags. Streaming is fastest to implement (fanout), but we need auth flows for tenant creds.
Priya (Legal): We need audit evidence retention aligned to SOC2: chain of custody, export integrity checks, and 90/365 retention options depending on customer class. Also require an ability to quarantine data for legal hold.
Chloe (Customer Success): Acme specifically wants the UI to show export completion + checksum and the ability to trigger re-exports. They will accept an initial manual key handoff process.
Aisha (Product): Proposal for MVP (6 weeks): (A) outbound streaming exports (per-tenant) with export manifest + checksum; (B) BYOK "handshake v1" CLI-assisted key registration (manual escrow later); (C) retention tags + a simple legal-hold flag that prevents deletion. No UI polish for v1.
Miguel (Security): MVP checklist add: signed export manifests (HMAC) and audit log of key registration events. Store minimal key metadata (kid, algo) but never the key material.
Devon (Engineering): Rough tech design snippet:
```
exporter -> per-tenant queue -> writer to tenant-bucket (s3://acme-audit/YYYY-MM-DD/partN.json)
manifest: {tenant, start_ts, end_ts, file_list, checksum, signature}
```
We also need an auth shim for tenant creds. Estimated 3w for streaming + 2w for manifest/signing + 1w legal-hold plumbing.
Priya (Legal): For compliance, retention policy must be configurable per-tenant and default to 90 days. Legal-hold must override retention until released. Ensure admin audit trail for hold actions.
Miguel (Security): Operational question: how do we handle reencryption if customer rotates keys? If we only stream to tenant buckets that's fine, but on-platform archives will need rewrap. For MVP, avoid on-platform key wrapping — mark as not eligible.
Aisha (Product): Agreement: MVP scope avoids on-platform key storage/re-encryption. We'll clearly document limitations. Launch criteria (must haves): export success path verified by CS with checksum, documented BYOK registration runbook, legal-hold works end-to-end in staging, product smoke tests + threat model review.
Devon (Engineering): One more tradeoff — batching vs real-time. Real-time increases cost but reduces time-to-evidence. Suggest default near-real-time (1m batch) for MVP.
Chloe (Customer Success): I'll line up Acme to test the staging flow next week. They can do the manual key registration CLI.
Priya (Legal): Also capture retention SLA in the contract appendix. I'll draft language.
Miguel (Security): I'll schedule a brief threat review and add HSM/KMS controls checklist.
ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed: staging/exporter v0.2 deployed at 2025-09-15T14:03Z :rocket:
Aisha (Product): OK next steps: 1) Eng to spike streaming auth shim (Devon), 2) Sec to define signing spec (Miguel), 3) Legal to draft contract appendix (Priya), 4) CS to coordinate test (Chloe). We'll sync EOW. :calendar:
Devon (Engineering): I'll put a draft design doc in the product-sprint board and tag this thread.
Chloe (Customer Success): Acme confirmed testing slot Thursday 10am PT.
Miguel (Security): Noted. Will have threat review notes by Wednesday.
Aisha (Product): thanks team — aiming to keep scope tight. If any blocker surfaces, flag here immediately. :thumbsup:
